newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil up with futures, barge premiums shaved.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil up with futures, barge premiums shaved.

text.p: NWE gas oil edged higher on Thursday on the back of firmer futures, but activity was thin and premiums weakened for some grades.
April IPE gas oil closed $1.75 stronger at $169.25 a tonne.
Heating oil barge premiums slipped 50 cents to $1 lower with trades concluded for second half March material at April IPE flat fob and later at April IPE -$1.
Diesel barges were also slow, although a German intermediate spec barge was sold at April IPE +$14 fob.

Cargo business appeared to be hampered by the screen strength amid concerns of some fundemental weakness. The contango that was seen on the March-April spread was now showing a conclusive backwardation on April-May of nearly $5 a tonne.
FOD was thinly talked, but put around April IPE +$1.5-2.5 cif NWE while Russians were pegged at about April IPE +$1-2. But Russians continue to be hard to source.
